UA-001.label: ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web) requires migration to ASP.NET Core MVC
UA-001.description: ASP.NET MVC 5 is built on System.Web which does not exist in .NET Core or .NET 5+. The entire web framework layer must be rewritten using ASP.NET Core MVC controllers, Razor views, and middleware pipeline.

UA-002.label: System.Web namespace not available in .NET 10
UA-002.description: All types from System.Web (HttpContext, HttpRequest, HttpResponse, HttpPostedFileBase, HttpServerUtility, etc.) are not available in .NET 10. Replace with Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http equivalents.

UA-003.label: Global.asax application lifecycle must be migrated
UA-003.description: Global.asax and Application_Start are not supported in .NET 10. Migrate startup logic to Program.cs and Startup.cs using the ASP.NET Core middleware pipeline and IHostedService.

UA-004.label: System.Configuration.ConfigurationManager not available
UA-004.description: ConfigurationManager is not available in .NET 10 (System.Configuration.dll ships with .NET Framework only). Replace with Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration and appsettings.json or environment variables.

UA-005.label: System.Web.Optimization (bundling) not supported
UA-005.description: Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization and BundleConfig are not available in .NET 10. Use libman, npm, or Webpack for client-side asset management in ASP.NET Core.

UA-006.label: System.Messaging (MSMQ) not available in .NET 10
UA-006.description: System.Messaging is a Windows-only .NET Framework assembly not included in .NET 10. Replace with Azure Service Bus, Azure Queue Storage, or the community package CoreWCF.Primitives for basic MSMQ migration.

UA-007.label: Entity Framework Core 3.1 must be upgraded to EF Core 9+
UA-007.description: EF Core 3.1 is end-of-life and incompatible with .NET 10. Upgrade to EF Core 9.0 or 10.0. Most DbContext and LINQ query code is compatible, but review deprecated APIs, migration tooling, and provider updates.

UA-008.label: Legacy .csproj format (non-SDK style) must be converted
UA-008.description: The project uses the legacy MSBuild project format with full Assembly/ProjectType GUIDs. Convert to SDK-style project format (.NET SDK .csproj) for .NET 10 compatibility. Use the sdk-style-conversion scenario.

UA-009.label: Razor views need migration from MVC 5 Razor to ASP.NET Core Razor
UA-009.description: Razor view syntax is mostly compatible, but MVC 5-specific helpers (@Html.Action, @Html.Partial, SelectList via ViewBag) may need updates. Tag Helpers replace many HTML helpers in ASP.NET Core.

UA-010.label: packages.config must be migrated to PackageReference
UA-010.description: The packages.config NuGet format is not supported in SDK-style projects. Migrate to PackageReference format. Many packages referenced (ASP.NET MVC, WebGrease, Antlr, WebPages) will be removed as they are replaced by ASP.NET Core packages.

UA-011.label: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient upgrade required
UA-011.description: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient 2.1.4 is outdated. Upgrade to the latest version (5.x) for .NET 10 compatibility and security patches.

UA-012.label: Newtonsoft.Json can be replaced with System.Text.Json
UA-012.description: Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3 is still compatible with .NET 10 but System.Text.Json is the built-in, high-performance alternative. Consider migrating for reduced dependencies and improved performance.
